title: Particle Dynamics Simulator — Overview and definition
t: Particle Dynamics Simulator — Overview and definition
description: Simulates granular, powder, and discrete-particle systems with contact physics.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Simulates granular, powder, and discrete-particle systems with contact physics. A particle dynamics simulator integrates Newton's equations for thousands to millions of discrete particles with Hertz-Mindlin contact, cohesion, and rolling friction. Real implementations include LIGGGHTS, MercuryDPM, and Rocky DEM. It predicts hopper flow, mixing, segregation, and milling with GPU acceleration.
